summary: PCA analysis and directed testing completed for NetworkManager commit 921fe6ec68a1cffc18a81752f996578831702ad7. Found 7 compatibility changes (3 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM, 2 LOW). 3 high-priority findings were verified by static analysis and existing unit tests; all confirm behavioral contract breaches. The patch changes arp_missed_max default from 0 to 2, normalizes 0 to 2, and adds input validation rejecting arp_missed_max>0 in TLB/ALB/802.3ad modes.
